name: 原初·暗器·T3·戒指
prompt:
Series priority: PRIMAL items must have their working body made from visibly curved BONE and bent ROOT/WOOD. Main palette is warm IVORY BONE, walnut wood, tan cloth and small AMBER or moss details; family colours are at most a tiny accent. No steel breastplate, steel blade centre, conventional leather-strapped knight shoulders, diamond jewel mounts or regular gear with vines pasted on it. Rebuild the whole outer silhouette as a grown organic wearable. Use broad arcs, open branching supports and organic asymmetry.
Use case: style-transfer / equipment redesign.
Asset type: ONE standalone transparent production game equipment icon, gear-primal-hidden-t3-ring.
Input images: game character and simple sword are positive cartoon DRAWING-STYLE references only; do not copy the sword steel material or old library silhouette.
Subject: one wearable band with clear finger hole and an offset three-lobed upper-right mounting.
Family identity across all six pieces: three separated curved lobes, offset loops, diagonal wraps and clear negative space.
Series palette priority: warm ivory bone, walnut roots/wood and tan cloth, with a small family-colour accent. No steel or conventional metal working body.
Series: PRIMAL -- warm ivory bone, bent dark wood/root, matte mineral/amber accents and woven leather/cloth; equipment has a naturally grown curved construction: smooth curved bone/wood pieces form the working body, open branching or curled joints and organic asymmetry. It must have a distinctly organic outer silhouette, not regular gear with two twigs pasted on it; no skull face, gore, aura or ornamental thorn clutter. The three series must be visibly different in their outer contour and material construction, even in greyscale.
Stage: T3 COMPLETE: give the family a clear complete contour, with one bold pair of extended side structures and THREE broad structural layers. Weapon guard/head has an unmistakable full wing/fork/open-frame form; clothing has broad silhouette-defining shoulders and a shaped lower edge; helmet has a large open crest; boots have a broad outward cuff; jewellery has a large readable paired mount. Do not merely add tiny gems or spikes; retain a strong simple central body.
Style: soft warm charcoal/brown outline, chunky rounded object proportions, matte hand-drawn colour blocks, TWO or THREE large shading planes, warm restrained highlights. Keep details broad and legible. Match the new simple chibi items, not the skinny ornate old library.
Composition: three-quarter view with setting facing upper-right, full ring band and a large unobstructed finger hole. Centred on a square transparent canvas, full object visible, longest visible extent roughly 78–82% of canvas, generous equal safety margin. Do not enlarge T3 beyond the common size.
At 32px the equipment part must read immediately; at 48px the family, series and stage must be recognisable by structure. Each icon depicts a coherent physical wearable or weapon, not a pasted symbol.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha; ONE isolated object (a pair only for boots). No background, floor, external cast shadow, frames, labels, text, numbers, rarity tags, characters, particles, glowing discs, tiny filigree or dense shiny rendering. Do not generate a sprite sheet or collage. The output is one production PNG.
The LAST reference is the completed BASIC T1 version of this exact equipment family and part. Preserve its broad drawing style and family palette, but DO NOT reuse its contour. Make the requested higher stage visibly different through the major outer guard/shoulder/crest/cuff/setting structures; it must not look like T1 with new engraving or extra gems.
normalization: Alpha-bounds crop; proportional Lanczos resize inside 208×208; centered on a transparent 256×256 canvas.
